prompt.zh-TW: 初陽貿易向供應商賒購一批商品 {{money:e1.amount}}，約定下個月付款。請寫出分錄。
prompt.en: First Light Trading buys goods worth {{money:e1.amount}} from a supplier on credit, payable next month. Write the journal entry.

explanation.zh-TW: 商品進來了，借記存貨 {{money:e1.amount}}；錢還沒付，欠供應商的是負債，貸記應付帳款 {{money:e1.amount}}。現金這一步沒動。注意是「應付」不是「應收」：應收帳款是別人欠我們的。
explanation.en: The goods have arrived, so debit inventory {{money:e1.amount}}; nothing has been paid, so what is owed to the supplier is a liability, credit trade payables {{money:e1.amount}}. Cash does not move at this step. Note payables, not receivables: receivables are what others owe us.
